segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to quickly walk through the revised quote for 42 seats and the implementation timeline we discussed last week.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. I have about 20 minutes. I did look at the quote, and the seat count is right for phase one. We may add five more in Q2, but not at go-live.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. So the current order form is 42 standard seats at $68 per seat per month, billed annually. That puts the subscription at $34,272 for the year, plus the one-time onboarding package at $4,800.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I have. On the invoice, can the onboarding fee be listed separately? Our finance team needs to code that to a different cost center.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can do that. I’ll note it for billing, separate line item for onboarding, cost center field included on the invoice. Do you need the PO number on there too?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, PO 41792. And the billing address should be the Denver office, not our headquarters in Chicago.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll update that in the CRM and make sure it flows through to the billing tool. For timing, if we get signature by Friday, March 15, we can start kickoff on March 25 and target go-live for May 6.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: May 6 is still fine. We have manager training the week of April 22, so as long as the sandbox is ready by then, we’re good.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that works. Our implementation lead has a sandbox handoff penciled in for April 18. I’ll include that milestone in the project notes and the welcome email.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Last thing, the order form says auto-renewal at 12 months. Legal asked if we can have 60 days’ notice instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s a standard change. I’ll send it to deal desk today and get the order form updated to 60 days’ notice. Should be back to you by tomorrow afternoon.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send the updated version to me and copy finance, and I’ll route it for signature once legal confirms.
